John Richardson's dates (1816–1879) are from https://hymnary.org/tune/tichfield_richardson (TICHFIELD, John Richardson; Praise! 2013 #593 prints 'John Richardson 1816-79'; the credit links to https://hymnary.org/person/Richardson_John1816, Richardson, John, 1816-1879); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2008064794 (Richardson, John, 1816-1879, citing British musical biography, 1897: b.
